session_summary: Sprint 9 complete: 8 UX/feature enhancements shipped across 8 commits on claude-enhancements. Removed busyness heuristic, fixed ferry icon re-registration on theme switch, improved mobile drawer 44px touch targets, updated API credits (4 sources), color-coded per-vessel trails with 5-min history, added Billy Bishop Airport dock/route (68 departures/day), fixed status-unknown pill with schedule fallback, condensed dock descriptions and added Next Arrivals section. QA: 73/73 frontend + 29/29 backend tests, zero TS/lint errors, 81KB app bundle. bd stats: 35/35 issues closed.

agent_feedback.worked_well: 6 simultaneous Docker containers with zero merge conflicts across overlapping files. The Billy Bishop agent proactively fixed a pre-existing MapLibre v5 type error (StyleDataEvent → MapStyleDataEvent) and implemented the styledata handler, making the icon-fix task redundant — good cross-task awareness. Schedule fallback for status pill was clean and correct on first attempt.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Task 2 (icon fix, max_turns=20) exited with code 1 and produced zero output — silent failure. When a task is very small (single file, one useEffect change), the agent may spend most turns reading before writing and run out before committing.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: For single-file targeted fixes, start with max_turns=25 not 20. Add a reminder in the role: if you have ≤5 turns remaining and have made changes, commit immediately before exploring further.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Made all correct CSS changes to PanelShell.css (44px touch targets, shadow, chevron styling, collapsed height 88px). Changes were complete and correct.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Hit max_turns=20 without committing — made all the right changes but ran out of turns before the git commit step. The agent spent turns reading and validating before writing.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Increase default max_turns for ui-designer to 30. Add explicit rule to the template: commit after typecheck+lint pass regardless of remaining turns — never let the session end with uncommitted verified changes.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Clean first-pass with zero regressions. Correctly flagged missing backend ESLint config as non-blocking tech debt rather than blocking the sprint. Bundle size reporting was useful.

overall_notes: Docker cold-start pattern: all containers showed 0-byte logs for 2+ minutes — normal, not a failure. Best practice: poll get_agent_output with block=false, then after 90s switch to direct tail of the log file via bash. Context compaction mid-sprint: bd ready + get_progress + git log --oneline are sufficient to fully reconstruct sprint state — no work was lost. Tech debt surfaced: server/package.json has no ESLint configured — worth adding in a future sprint.
